The name Anaza carries the meaning “Graceful, flowing water” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anaza usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, flowing water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
